item.title: Log of Anomalous Tales a Go-Go
item.content:encoded:
I don't know what to say about this; it's a cold post about something on the Log of Anomalous Items, for Westrin's Log of Anomalous Tales challenge.

I went over about a dozen different ways to do this particular object, including:

  • A pair of Foundation scientists arguing about OOPArts (out of place artifacts; think the Antikythera mechanism) and how this was clearly a hoax, only for the unfossilized remains of a stegosaurus to be found somewhere in Sicily.
  • A tiger hunt near the Caspian Sea that had somehow gone horribly wrong, and the hunters running afoul of a herd of stegosauruses.
  • An ancient Herman-Fuller equivalent having anomalous animals in their circus/menagerie, and someone freeing those animals to run on the streets of the town, an event recounted in the mosaics.

This is… perhaps not the best way to do it, but it's the way that worked the best for me. Enjoy!
